시편-149-1.title: 시편 149장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-1.exegesis: 14. exalteth the horn-- established power ( Psa 75:5 , 6 ). praise of-- or literally, "for" his saints-- that is, occasions for them to praise Him. They are further described as "His people," and "near unto Him," sustaining by covenanted care a peculiarly intimate relation.
시편-149-1.theologicalNote: 14. exalteth the horn-- established power ( Psa 75:5 , 6 ). praise of-- or literally, "for" his saints-- that is, occasions for them to praise Him. They are further described as "His people," and "near unto Him," sustaining by covenanted care a peculiarly intimate relation.

시편-149-2.title: 시편 149장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-2.exegesis: PSALM 149 Psa 149:1-9 . This Psalm sustains a close connection with the foregoing. The chosen people are exhorted to praise God, in view of past favors, and also future victories over enemies, of which they are impliedly assured. 1. (Compare Psa 96:1 ).
시편-149-2.theologicalNote: PSALM 149 Psa 149:1-9 . This Psalm sustains a close connection with the foregoing. The chosen people are exhorted to praise God, in view of past favors, and also future victories over enemies, of which they are impliedly assured. 1. (Compare Psa 96:1 ).

시편-149-3.title: 시편 149장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-3.exegesis: 2. God had signalized His relation as a sovereign, in restoring them to their land.
시편-149-3.theologicalNote: 2. God had signalized His relation as a sovereign, in restoring them to their land.

시편-149-4.title: 시편 149장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-4.exegesis: 3. in the dance-- ( Psa 30:11 ). The dance is connected with other terms, expressive of the great joy of the occasion. The word may be rendered "lute," to which the other instruments are joined. sing praises-- or, sing and play.
시편-149-4.theologicalNote: 3. in the dance-- ( Psa 30:11 ). The dance is connected with other terms, expressive of the great joy of the occasion. The word may be rendered "lute," to which the other instruments are joined. sing praises-- or, sing and play.

시편-149-5.title: 시편 149장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-5.exegesis: 4. taketh pleasure-- literally, "accepts," alluding to acceptance of propitiatory offerings (compare Psa 147:11 ). beautify, &c.-- adorn the humble with faith, hope, joy, and peace.
시편-149-5.theologicalNote: 4. taketh pleasure-- literally, "accepts," alluding to acceptance of propitiatory offerings (compare Psa 147:11 ). beautify, &c.-- adorn the humble with faith, hope, joy, and peace.

시편-149-6.title: 시편 149장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-6.exegesis: 5. in glory-- the honorable condition to which they are raised. upon their beds-- once a place of mourning ( Psa 6:6 ).
시편-149-6.theologicalNote: 5. in glory-- the honorable condition to which they are raised. upon their beds-- once a place of mourning ( Psa 6:6 ).

시편-149-7.title: 시편 149장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-7.exegesis: 6. high praises-- or, "deeds." They shall go forth as religious warriors, as once religious laborers ( Ne 4:17 ).
시편-149-7.theologicalNote: 6. high praises-- or, "deeds." They shall go forth as religious warriors, as once religious laborers ( Ne 4:17 ).

시편-149-8.title: 시편 149장 8절 역사문법적 주해
시편-149-8.exegesis: 7. The destruction of the incorrigibly wicked attends the propagation of God's truth, so that the military successes of the Jews, after the captivity, typified the triumphs of the Gospel.
시편-149-8.theologicalNote: 7. The destruction of the incorrigibly wicked attends the propagation of God's truth, so that the military successes of the Jews, after the captivity, typified the triumphs of the Gospel.
